description:
The background used in Mario's cutscenes in the Japan-only SNES game "Mario no Super Picross". No credit needed.

NOTE: For best results, set horizontal BG scrolling to none. Also, the included HDMA gradient code (insert with uberASM) is optional, but recommended.
